```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from pathlib import Path
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.stats.weightstats import DescrStatsW
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')

FIGDIR = Path("resultados/figures")
FIGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def save_fig(fig, name):
    fig.savefig(FIGDIR / f"{name}.svg", bbox_inches='tight')
    fig.savefig(FIGDIR / f"{name}.pdf", bbox_inches='tight')
    print(f"Saved {name}.svg and {name}.pdf")

PALETTE = {
    'treated': '#55B4AE', 'control': '#C5361D', 'point': '#1f77b4',
    'pos01': '#1a6faf', 'pos05': '#5ba4d4', 'pos10': '#a8cce4',
    'neg01': '#c0392b', 'neg05': '#e67e73', 'neg10': '#f1b9b5', 'ns': '#b0b0b0',
}

def sig_stars(p):
    if pd.isna(p): return ''
    if p < 0.01:   return '***'
    if p < 0.05:   return '**'
    if p < 0.10:   return '*'
    return ''

def dot_color(p, coef):
    if p < 0.01: return PALETTE['pos01'] if coef > 0 else PALETTE['neg01']
    if p < 0.05: return PALETTE['pos05'] if coef > 0 else PALETTE['neg05']
    if p < 0.10: return PALETTE['pos10'] if coef > 0 else PALETTE['neg10']
    return PALETTE['ns']
```

## Setup: Data and Main Model

Mirrors `regression_results_oophe.qmd` §0/§3/§5 exactly.

```{python}
#| label: setup-main-model
panel_path  = Path("resultados/access_analysis_panel.csv")
states_path = Path("resultados/state_covariates.csv")
df          = pd.read_csv(panel_path)
df_states   = pd.read_csv(states_path)

df = df[df['income'] <= df['income'].quantile(0.9999)].copy()

household_controls = [
    'log_income', 'head_sex', 'head_age', 'head_education',
    'household_size', 'economic_dependency_ratio', 'locality_rural',
]

year_dummies  = pd.get_dummies(df['year'],       prefix='y', drop_first=True, dtype=int)
state_dummies = pd.get_dummies(df['state_code'], prefix='s', drop_first=True, dtype=int)
df_reg = pd.concat([df, year_dummies, state_dummies], axis=1)
df_reg_f = df_reg.merge(df_states, on=['state_code', 'year'], how='left')
state_covariate_cols = [c for c in df_states.columns if c not in ('state_code', 'year')]

x_cols_did = (
    ['treated_x_post'] + household_controls + state_covariate_cols
    + list(year_dummies.columns) + list(state_dummies.columns)
)
data_did = df_reg_f[['log_oop_expenditure', 'oop_expenditure', 'state_code', 'factor'] + x_cols_did].dropna().copy()
X_did = sm.add_constant(data_did[x_cols_did].astype(float))

model_did = sm.GLM(
    data_did['oop_expenditure'].astype(float), X_did, family=sm.families.Poisson(),
    var_weights=data_did['factor'].astype(float)
).fit(cov_type='cluster', cov_kwds={'groups': data_did['state_code']})

coef_table = pd.DataFrame({
    'coef': model_did.params, 'std_err': model_did.bse, 'p_value': model_did.pvalues,
})
coef_table['pct_change'] = 100 * (np.exp(coef_table['coef']) - 1)

te = coef_table.loc['treated_x_post']
print(f"Main model refit check — should match regression_results_oophe.qmd §5:")
print(f"N={len(data_did):,}, treated_x_post = {te['pct_change']:+.1f}%, p={te['p_value']:.3f} "
      f"(expected: +23.0%, p=0.001)")
```

```{python}
#| label: setup-event-study
event_cols = []
for y in [2016, 2018, 2022, 2024]:
    col = f'event_{y}'
    df_reg_f[col] = df_reg_f['treated'] * (df_reg_f['year'] == y).astype(int)
    event_cols.append(col)

x_cols_es = event_cols + household_controls + state_covariate_cols + list(year_dummies.columns) + list(state_dummies.columns)
data_es = df_reg_f[['oop_expenditure', 'state_code', 'factor'] + x_cols_es].dropna().copy()
X_es = sm.add_constant(data_es[x_cols_es].astype(float))
model_es = sm.GLM(
    data_es['oop_expenditure'].astype(float), X_es, family=sm.families.Poisson(),
    var_weights=data_es['factor'].astype(float)
).fit(cov_type='cluster', cov_kwds={'groups': data_es['state_code']})

years_plot = [2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024]
es_coefs = [model_es.params.get(f'event_{y}', 0) for y in years_plot]
es_errs  = [model_es.bse.get(f'event_{y}', 0) * 1.96 for y in years_plot]
```

```{python}
#| label: setup-robustness

y_log = data_did['log_oop_expenditure'].astype(float)
model_log_ols = sm.OLS(y_log, X_did).fit(cov_type='cluster', cov_kwds={'groups': data_did['state_code']})
model_wls = sm.WLS(y_log, X_did, weights=data_did['factor']).fit(
    cov_type='cluster', cov_kwds={'groups': data_did['state_code']}
)

def fit_alt_cutoff(cutoff_year):
    col = f'treated_x_post_{cutoff_year}'
    df_reg_f[col] = df_reg_f['treated'] * (df_reg_f['year'] >= cutoff_year).astype(int)
    x_cols = [col] + household_controls + state_covariate_cols + list(year_dummies.columns) + list(state_dummies.columns)
    data = df_reg_f[['oop_expenditure', 'state_code', 'factor'] + x_cols].dropna().copy()
    X = sm.add_constant(data[x_cols].astype(float))
    model = sm.GLM(
        data['oop_expenditure'].astype(float), X, family=sm.families.Poisson(),
        var_weights=data['factor'].astype(float)
    ).fit(cov_type='cluster', cov_kwds={'groups': data['state_code']})
    return model, col

model_alt_2018, col_2018 = fit_alt_cutoff(2018)
model_alt_2022, col_2022 = fit_alt_cutoff(2022)

df_excl2020 = df_reg_f[df_reg_f['year'] != 2020].copy()
year_cols_excl2020 = [c for c in year_dummies.columns if c != 'y_2020']
x_cols_excl2020 = ['treated_x_post'] + household_controls + state_covariate_cols + year_cols_excl2020 + list(state_dummies.columns)
data_excl2020 = df_excl2020[['oop_expenditure', 'state_code', 'factor'] + x_cols_excl2020].dropna().copy()
X_excl2020 = sm.add_constant(data_excl2020[x_cols_excl2020].astype(float))
model_excl2020 = sm.GLM(
    data_excl2020['oop_expenditure'].astype(float), X_excl2020, family=sm.families.Poisson(),
    var_weights=data_excl2020['factor'].astype(float)
).fit(cov_type='cluster', cov_kwds={'groups': data_excl2020['state_code']})

spec_rows = [
    {'label': 'Main (post = 2020)', 'coef': model_did.params['treated_x_post'], 'se': model_did.bse['treated_x_post'], 'p': model_did.pvalues['treated_x_post']},
    {'label': 'post = 2018',        'coef': model_alt_2018.params[col_2018],    'se': model_alt_2018.bse[col_2018],    'p': model_alt_2018.pvalues[col_2018]},
    {'label': 'post = 2022',        'coef': model_alt_2022.params[col_2022],    'se': model_alt_2022.bse[col_2022],    'p': model_alt_2022.pvalues[col_2022]},
    {'label': 'Excluding 2020',     'coef': model_excl2020.params['treated_x_post'], 'se': model_excl2020.bse['treated_x_post'], 'p': model_excl2020.pvalues['treated_x_post']},
    {'label': 'Log-OLS on log(1+y)', 'coef': model_log_ols.params['treated_x_post'], 'se': model_log_ols.bse['treated_x_post'], 'p': model_log_ols.pvalues['treated_x_post']},
    {'label': 'WLS on log(1+y)',     'coef': model_wls.params['treated_x_post'],     'se': model_wls.bse['treated_x_post'],     'p': model_wls.pvalues['treated_x_post']},
]
spec_df = pd.DataFrame(spec_rows)
spec_df['pct']   = 100 * (np.exp(spec_df['coef']) - 1)
spec_df['ci_lo'] = 100 * (np.exp(spec_df['coef'] - 1.96 * spec_df['se']) - 1)
spec_df['ci_hi'] = 100 * (np.exp(spec_df['coef'] + 1.96 * spec_df['se']) - 1)
spec_df['signif'] = spec_df['p'].apply(sig_stars)
spec_df
```

```{python}
#| label: setup-subcategory-models

SUBCATEGORIES = ['medicines', 'hospital', 'outpatient_care']
SUBCAT_LABELS = {'oop_expenditure': 'Total OOP spending', 'medicines': 'Medicines',
                  'hospital': 'Hospital', 'outpatient_care': 'Outpatient care'}

def fit_main_model(df_raw, outcome_col, df_states, trim=True):
    d = df_raw.copy()
    if trim:
        d = d[d['income'] <= d['income'].quantile(0.9999)].copy()
    yd = pd.get_dummies(d['year'], prefix='y', drop_first=True, dtype=int)
    sd = pd.get_dummies(d['state_code'], prefix='s', drop_first=True, dtype=int)
    dr = pd.concat([d, yd, sd], axis=1)
    drf = dr.merge(df_states, on=['state_code', 'year'], how='left')
    scc = [c for c in df_states.columns if c not in ('state_code', 'year')]
    xc = ['treated_x_post'] + household_controls + scc + list(yd.columns) + list(sd.columns)
    data = drf[[outcome_col, 'state_code', 'factor'] + xc].dropna().copy()
    X = sm.add_constant(data[xc].astype(float))
    model = sm.GLM(
        data[outcome_col].astype(float), X, family=sm.families.Poisson(),
        var_weights=data['factor'].astype(float)
    ).fit(cov_type='cluster', cov_kwds={'groups': data['state_code']})
    return model, data

df_raw_subcat = pd.read_csv(panel_path)
df_raw_subcat = df_raw_subcat[df_raw_subcat['income'] <= df_raw_subcat['income'].quantile(0.9999)].copy()

subcat_results = {}
for col in SUBCATEGORIES + ['oop_expenditure']:
    if col == 'oop_expenditure':
        m, d = model_did, data_did
    else:
        m, d = fit_main_model(df_raw_subcat, col, df_states)
    subcat_results[col] = {'model': m, 'N': len(d)}
    print(f"Fitted {col:16s}  N={len(d):,}  %Δ={100*(np.exp(m.params['treated_x_post'])-1):+.1f}%  "
          f"p={m.pvalues['treated_x_post']:.3f}")
```

# Main Text Figures


## Figure 1. Parallel Trends and Event Study

```{python}
#| label: fig1
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 5))

ax = axes[0]
trend = df.groupby(['year', 'treated']).apply(
    lambda g: pd.Series({'mean': DescrStatsW(g['oop_expenditure'].values, weights=g['factor'].values).mean})
).reset_index()

for t, color, label in [(0, PALETTE['control'], 'Control (never affiliated)'), (1, PALETTE['treated'], 'Treated')]:
    sub = trend[trend['treated'] == t].sort_values('year')
    ax.plot(sub['year'], sub['mean'], marker='o', color=color, label=label)
ax.axvline(2020, color='grey', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7, label='Reform (INSABI, 2020)')
ax.set_title('A. Mean Quarterly OOP Spending', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Survey Year'); ax.set_ylabel('Mean OOP spend (2024 pesos)')
ax.set_xticks([2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024])
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper left')
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)

ax = axes[1]
ax.errorbar(years_plot, es_coefs, yerr=es_errs, fmt='o-', color='black', capsize=4)
ax.axhline(0, color='red', linestyle='--', lw=1)
ax.axvspan(2019.5, 2020.5, color='grey', alpha=0.15)
ax.set_title('B. Event-Study Coefficients (ref. year = 2020)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Year'); ax.set_ylabel('Treated × Year (log points)')
ax.set_xticks([2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024])
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)

fig.suptitle('Figure 1. Parallel Trends and Event-Study Estimates', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', y=1.03)
plt.tight_layout()
save_fig(fig, 'fig1_parallel_trends_event_study')
plt.show()
```

## Figure 2. Sensitivity of the Treatment Effect to Specification Choice

```{python}
#| label: fig2
plot_df = spec_df.sort_values('pct').reset_index(drop=True)
y_pos = np.arange(len(plot_df))
colors = [dot_color(row['p'], row['coef']) for _, row in plot_df.iterrows()]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4.5))
for i, row in plot_df.iterrows():
    ax.plot([row['ci_lo'], row['ci_hi']], [y_pos[i], y_pos[i]], color=colors[i], lw=4, alpha=0.8, solid_capstyle='round')
ax.scatter(plot_df['pct'], y_pos, color=colors, s=80, zorder=3, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.8)
for i, row in plot_df.iterrows():
    ax.text(row['ci_hi'] + 2, y_pos[i], f"{row['pct']:+.1f}%{row['signif']}", va='center', fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(0, color='#555', lw=1, linestyle='--')
ax.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax.set_yticklabels(plot_df['label'], fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlabel('Estimated %Δ in expected OOP spend (95% CI)', fontsize=10)
ax.set_title('Figure 2. Sensitivity of the Treatment Effect to Specification Choice', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle=':')
ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
fig.text(0.02, -0.06,
    "Note: Log-OLS/WLS %Δ are log(1+y) semi-elasticities and are not directly comparable in\n"
    "magnitude to the PPML rows. The extensive-margin logit check (different scale: probability\n"
    "points, not %-change) is reported in-text only.", fontsize=7.5, ha='left')
plt.tight_layout()
save_fig(fig, 'fig2_specification_comparison')
plt.show()
```

## Figure A1. Zero-Inflated Distributions of OOP Spending

```{python}
#| label: figA1
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(11, 8))

for ax, col in zip(axes.flat, outcomes_a1):
    vals = df_raw_subcat[col]
    zero_share = (vals == 0).mean()
    nonzero = vals[vals > 0]
```

## Figure A3. Marginal Relationships — Income and Treatment

```{python}
#| label: figA3
beta_map = coef_table['coef'].to_dict()
X_mean = data_did[x_cols_did].astype(float).mean()

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.5))

ax = axes[0]
tmp = data_did[['log_income', 'oop_expenditure']].copy()
tmp['_bin'] = pd.qcut(tmp['log_income'], 20, duplicates='drop')
binned = tmp.groupby('_bin', observed=True).agg(x=('log_income', 'mean'), y=('oop_expenditure', 'mean')).reset_index(drop=True)
ax.scatter(binned['x'], binned['y'], color=PALETTE['point'], s=30, zorder=3, label='Binned mean (20 quantile bins)')

x_grid = np.linspace(data_did['log_income'].min(), data_did['log_income'].max(), 100)
baseline = X_mean.copy()
preds = []
for val in x_grid:
    row = baseline.copy(); row['log_income'] = val
    lin = beta_map.get('const', 0) + sum(beta_map.get(c, 0) * row[c] for c in x_cols_did)
    preds.append(np.exp(lin))
ax.plot(x_grid, preds, color='black', lw=2, label='Predicted E[OOP spend]')
ax.set_title('A. Log Household Income', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Log household income'); ax.set_ylabel('OOP spend (pesos)')
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(alpha=0.25)

ax = axes[1]
preds01 = []
for val in [0, 1]:
    row = X_mean.copy(); row['treated_x_post'] = val
    lin = beta_map.get('const', 0) + sum(beta_map.get(c, 0) * row[c] for c in x_cols_did)
    preds01.append(np.exp(lin))
ax.bar(['Control /\nPre-period', 'Treated &\nPost-period'], preds01, color=[PALETTE['control'], PALETTE['treated']], width=0.5)
te = coef_table.loc['treated_x_post']
ax.annotate(f"{te['pct_change']:+.1f}%, p={te['p_value']:.3f}", xy=(0.5, max(preds01) * 1.05), ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax.set_title('B. Treatment × Post (other covariates at sample mean)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylabel('Predicted OOP spend (pesos)')
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.25)

fig.suptitle('Figure A3. Marginal Relationships — Income and Treatment', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
plt.tight_layout()
save_fig(fig, 'figA3_marginal_effects_binned')
plt.show()
```

## Figure A4. Event-Study Estimates by Subcategory

```{python}
#| label: figA4
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 4.5))

for ax, col in zip(axes, SUBCATEGORIES):
    d = df_raw_subcat.copy()
    yd = pd.get_dummies(d['year'], prefix='y', drop_first=True, dtype=int)
    sd = pd.get_dummies(d['state_code'], prefix='s', drop_first=True, dtype=int)
    dr = pd.concat([d, yd, sd], axis=1)
    drf = dr.merge(df_states, on=['state_code', 'year'], how='left')
    scc = [c for c in df_states.columns if c not in ('state_code', 'year')]
    ecols = []
    for y in [2016, 2018, 2022, 2024]:
        c = f'event_{y}'
        drf[c] = drf['treated'] * (drf['year'] == y).astype(int)
        ecols.append(c)
    xc = ecols + household_controls + scc + list(yd.columns) + list(sd.columns)
    data = drf[[col, 'state_code', 'factor'] + xc].dropna().copy()
    X = sm.add_constant(data[xc].astype(float))
    m = sm.GLM(
        data[col].astype(float), X, family=sm.families.Poisson(), var_weights=data['factor'].astype(float)
    ).fit(cov_type='cluster', cov_kwds={'groups': data['state_code']})

    yrs = [2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024]
    cs = [m.params.get(f'event_{y}', 0) for y in yrs]
    es = [m.bse.get(f'event_{y}', 0) * 1.96 for y in yrs]
    ax.errorbar(yrs, cs, yerr=es, fmt='o-', color='black', capsize=4)
    ax.axhline(0, color='red', linestyle='--', lw=1)
    ax.axvspan(2019.5, 2020.5, color='grey', alpha=0.15)
    ax.set_title(SUBCAT_LABELS[col], fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
    ax.set_xlabel('Year'); ax.set_xticks(yrs)
    ax.grid(alpha=0.25)

axes[0].set_ylabel('Treated × Year (log points, rel. to 2020)')
fig.suptitle('Figure A4. Event-Study Estimates by Subcategory', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', y=1.03)
plt.tight_layout()
save_fig(fig, 'figA4_subcategory_event_studies')
plt.show()
```

## Figure A5. Mean Quarterly OOP Spending by Subcategory and Treatment Status

```{python}
#| label: figA5

        g = df[df['treated'] == t]
        d = DescrStatsW(g[col].values, weights=g['factor'].values)
        bar_rows.append({'outcome': col, 'treated': t, 'mean': d.mean})
bar_df = pd.DataFrame(bar_rows)

    sub = bar_df[bar_df['treated'] == t].set_index('outcome').loc[outcomes_a5]
    ax.bar(x + offset, sub['mean'], width, color=color, label=label, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
ax.set_xticks(x)
```
